scope: Official public billing, project controls, rate limits and exact Nano product pricing only. No account access, credentials, billing mutations or model calls by this reviewer.

conclusions.credits_exhausted_behavior: Current documentation allows negative balances and automatic collection. Do not rely on the legacy negative-balance API-error statement without account-specific verification.

sources.title: Billing & Consumption
findings: Balances are debited in real time. A card is automatically charged when a configured billing threshold is reached or at month start if the balance is negative. Failed collection suspends the account.
Promo credits increase the balance but cannot settle outstanding invoices.
Organization Usage filters monitor consumption; the page does not document a zero-overdraft setting or a provider-enforced project/key monetary cap.

sources.title: Billing
findings: Older billing instructions describe optional automatic top-ups and API errors when balance is negative.
These differ from the current linked Billing & Consumption page. Auto-top-up off alone cannot establish that the current account has no automatic collection.

sources.title: Organizations and Projects
findings: Projects organize resources and permissions, including API keys. This page does not document a project/key monetary budget. Absence from this page is not proof that no console feature exists.

sources.title: Rate Limits & Scaling
findings: Limits dynamically adjust in rolling 15-minute windows, potentially to 20 times the base allocation.
Over-limit requests may still be processed with spare capacity. RPM/TPM and their continuously replenishing counters do not impose a daily dollar budget.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron models inference
sources.retrieval_limit: Official search result contains the full Nano pricing section; direct page open returned an accessibility error.
findings: Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B public endpoint: US$0.06 per million input tokens and US$0.24 per million output tokens; 262K context, FP8.

model_pricing.scope: Public product rates; no dedicated endpoint, batch, cache, tax or negotiated pricing assumed.

implementation_inference.recommendation: Use a persistent daily request/token/cost reservation before dispatch with a concurrency lock, fixed model and max output, no retries, and retain reservations for ambiguous outcomes. This bounds this application only; it does not stop other keys or provider automatic collection.
implementation_inference.account_followup: Root must reconcile the authenticated billing settings and account-effective terms before claiming credits-only service or no cash overage.
